description: A physical legal/compliance document (Commercial Registration, Municipal License, Iqama, Civil Defense certificate…) belonging to a company, party, property, lease, or land, tracked so operators are reminded before it expires. Perpetual documents (Title Deed, VAT) carry no expiry and never trigger a reminder.

fields.description: Fetched from the Document Type — a perpetual document (deed / VAT) never expires and is excluded from reminders.
fields.label: Perpetual

fields.description: Issuing authority (Ministry of Commerce, Baladiya, Ejar, Jawazat, Civil Defense…).
fields.label: Issuer

fields.description: Gregorian expiry — the single source of truth for reminders. Required unless the document type is perpetual.
fields.label: Expiry Date

fields.description: Optional Hijri expiry as printed on the document (display only — no date math runs on it).
fields.label: Hijri Expiry (display)

fields.description: The kind of entity this document belongs to.
fields.label: Entity Type
fields.options:
Company
Customer
Supplier
Property
Lease Contract
Land

fields.description: The company that owns this document — the scoping / permission anchor (a Dynamic Link does not cascade permissions).
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Optional — the person responsible for renewing this document.
fields.label: Responsible

fields.description: Only Active documents are swept for expiry. 'Renewal In Progress' silences the reminder while the operator renews it; 'Superseded' is set automatically when a renewed copy replaces this one.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Active
Renewal In Progress
Superseded
Cancelled

fields.description: The earlier document this one renewed/replaced — forms a version chain (walk back to see every prior copy). Set automatically by the Renew action.
fields.label: Supersedes

name: Legal Document
